changelog:
eo-ability-architect 1.0.0

- Initial release of system architecture design skill.
- Provides architecture diagrams, technology stack recommendations, module breakdowns, and risk/complexity assessments.
- Supports integration with EO workflows (blog, miniprogram, security audit) and independent usage.
- Offers two modes: with EO plugin (access to expert library and advanced predictions) and without EO (LLM-based general suggestions).
- Includes sample usage and interface definitions for input/output.
